map.输入分辨率与对角线英寸，计算 PPI、长宽比、屏幕实际宽高: Enter resolution and diagonal inches to calculate PPI, aspect ratio, and actual screen width/height
map.对角线像素 = √(宽像素² + 高像素²)；PPI 像素密度 = 对角线像素: Diagonal pixels = √(width pixels² + height pixels²); PPI pixel density = diagonal pixels ÷ diagonal inches (1920 × 1080, 24-inch about 92 PPI); physical width = diagonal × width pixels ÷ diagonal pixels, physical height likewise; PPI below 110 shows visible pixels, above 200 displays finely; screen area = physical width × physical height, aspect ratio = width pixels ÷ height pixels.
map.提示：PPI 越高显示越细腻，手机一般 300+ PPI 为视网膜级别。长宽比化: Tip: higher PPI means finer display; phones generally at 300+ PPI are Retina level. Aspect ratio simplification uses the greatest common divisor.
map.选购显示器/手机/投影时由分辨率与对角线算 PPI，判断清晰度是否够用。: When buying a monitor/phone/projector, compute PPI from resolution and diagonal to judge whether clarity is sufficient.
map.对比同分辨率不同尺寸（如 24 寸 1080p vs 27 寸 1080p）的像: Compare pixel density differences of the same resolution at different sizes (e.g. 24-inch 1080p vs 27-inch 1080p).
map.换算实际显示宽高（英寸/厘米）与宽高比，确认桌面或壁挂适配。: Convert actual display width/height (inches/cm) and aspect ratio to confirm desktop or wall-mount fit.
map.对角线像素=√(1920²+1080²)≈2202.9，PPI=2202.9/2: Diagonal pixels = √(1920²+1080²) ≈ 2202.9, PPI = 2202.9/23.8 ≈ 92.56; actual display width = 1920/92.56 ≈ 20.74 inches, height ≈ 11.67 inches; aspect ratio = 1920:1080 simplified to 16:9; dot pitch = 25.4/92.56 ≈ 0.274 mm. If switched to 27-inch 2560×1440, PPI rises to 108.79, text is finer.
map.PPI 多高算清晰？: How high a PPI counts as sharp?
map.约 90–110 PPI 为常见桌面舒适区间；手机因观看距离近常 400+ PP: About 90–110 PPI is a common comfortable desktop range; phones often 400+ PPI due to close viewing distance. At the same resolution, smaller size means higher PPI (denser pixels), but too small strains the eyes; projectors or TVs at far viewing distance are clear even at low PPI.
map.宽高比怎么从分辨率得到？: How is the aspect ratio obtained from resolution?
